title: Le parcours de la Diagonale des Fous (15–18 octobre 2026)
claims: The 2026 Diagonale des Fous starts on Thursday 15 October 2026 at 22:00 from Ravine Blanche in Saint-Pierre and finishes in Saint-Denis.
The race characteristics block lists Trail XXL, 180 km and 10,200 m of positive gain.
The page introduction describes the course as approximately 180 kilometres.
The official time limit is 66 hours, the entry fee is €260 and the field is capped at 3,000 participants.
The route crosses the Réunion national park (Pitons, Cirques and Remparts), a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Pre-race reconnaissance between Bassin Plat and Piton Sec is formally forbidden because the land is private.
Some passages cross private land and are accessible only during the race, and the route may be modified for administrative, practical or path-condition reasons.
The organiser lists ambulance, Croix Blanche, doctor, nurse, physiotherapist, podiatrist, osteopath and rescuer cover.
The use of any type of trekking pole is formally forbidden under penalty.
